assessment_type: AI-assisted preliminary quality and evidence assessment

completed: Cross-checked all 102 registry course records, their per-level lesson counts, projects, capstones, exercises, quizzes and automated check results.

Inspected Git repository tree structure for public course source repositories where accessible; noted the Ethical Hacking source retrieval limitation and MCP/Vector Databases Python monorepo mappings.

Sampled five representative page excerpts (one lesson from each level plus the capstone) for Product Manager Mastery Path and Project Manager Mastery Path, reviewing titles, framing, subject focus and capstone direction. This was not a line-by-line read of every document.
Compared all 40 instructional Markdown files in each of the Product Manager and Project Manager repositories by Git blob SHA; zero identical instructional file hashes were found.
not_completed: A human has not personally read and signed off the 510 representative pages (five per course).
Full line-by-line content review of all five sample documents for every course is not complete; only the two management courses received targeted excerpt-level content sampling.
Runnable code, lab instructions, external links, screenshots, quizzes and answer keys have not been independently executed or independently fact-checked across all courses.

duplicate_decision.decision_basis: Distinct professional outcomes and learning objectives; separate course outlines and capstones; zero identical instructional Markdown blobs across 40 instructional pages in each repository.
duplicate_decision.classification: owner-authorised decision supported by AI-assisted source comparison

key_findings.finding: Latest registry audit reports all 102 courses passing automated checks, with zero failed lesson URLs and zero unresolved duplicate candidates.
All 3,672 registered lessons have an exercise; there are zero lesson exercise gaps.
The inventory distinguishes 306 projects from 102 capstones.
Maintain a separate human review record for each course only after a named person has actually inspected and attested to the required sample pages.

Ethical Hacking source access resolved 2026-11-24 (default branch is master, not main; see registry/ethical-hacking-source-ownership.json). Still open: inspect MCP/Vector Databases inside their respective Python monorepo subdirectories.

qualification_notice: This file records an AI-assisted assessment requested by the owner. It is not a substitute for the human review register registry/reviews.json, and it must not be used to claim that all courses have been human reviewed or independently certified.
